content.text: Let me fix each claim based on the fact checker's feedback.

{"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"The ProtoSense module watches Modbus and BACnet traffic but lacks a reliable method to flag deviations, partly because no client has provided a packet capture containing a confirmed attack.","sources":[{"id":"C001-CH1","field":"detail","quote":"none of our clients has ever given us a packet capture that contains a confirmed attack"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"The company has collected several terabytes of packet captures from consenting clients over the past three years for use in the project.","sources":[{"id":"C001-CH1","field":"detail","quote":"several terabytes of captures from consenting clients over the past three years"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"Anomalies are identified by measuring reconstruction error against learned normal patterns, without requiring labelled attack data, a method evaluated on synthetic attack scenarios.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10523","field":"abstract","quote":"Anomalies are identified by measuring reconstruction error against learned normal patterns, without requiring labelled attack data"}]},{"claim":4,"text":"The researcher's published work covers an unsupervised anomaly detection framework specifically designed for Modbus traffic analysis, and the company's traffic archives could provide additional real-world validation data.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10523","field":"abstract","quote":"unsupervised anomaly detection framework specifically designed for Modbus traffic analysis"},{"id":"C001-CH1","field":"detail","quote":"several terabytes of captures from consenting clients over the past three years"}]},{"claim":5,"text":"The project involves model development by the university researcher and hardware and firmware integration work by company engineers, who maintain the hardware bench and physical PLC simulators.","sources":[{"id":"C001","field":"tech","quote":"Hardware-in-the-loop bench testing with physical PLC simulators"}]}]}
